description: Take a picture with the rover's forward-facing camera (needs the camera module). Returns a 320×240 first-person PNG (walls, colored obstacles, colored floor tape, the light source) and a JSON list of what is in view: type (obstacle / tape / light), id, color, bearing_deg (0 = straight ahead, + = right) and distance_cm.

fov_deg.description: Change the horizontal field of view first (default 60°)

name: capture_camera
title: Capture camera image
